report.summary: Found 3 flag-interaction bugs in daedalus/structcore/index.py. 1) _scope_key (not shown) may not include wiki flag, causing cache collision between wiki-on and wiki-off builds. 2) _collect_docs and _collect share max_files limit independently, so documents can be truncated while code is not, producing a half-built index. 3) types_enabled gate is after per-file extraction (unconditional), so a layer-off build can serve a cache hit to a layer-on build, yielding empty type block silently. Also, wiki_enabled flag is defined but not used in build_index (not shown), so it may be dead code or missing
risks: Cache key collision: if _scope_key omits wiki flag, a wiki-on build may reuse a wiki-off cache entry, losing wiki edges silently.

Asymmetric truncation: _collect_docs and _collect each enforce max_files independently, so a repo with many docs may have docs truncated while code is fully indexed, producing a half-built index with no warning.

Silent type degradation: per-file type extraction is unconditional, so a layer-off build populates the cache; a subsequent layer-on build may hit the cache and skip resolution, yielding empty type_nodes/type_edges with no error.
Wiki flag may be dead code: wiki_enabled is defined but not referenced in the provided excerpt; if build_index does not use it, the flag has no effect.
todos: Verify _scope_key includes wiki flag; if not, add it.
Add warning or unified limit when documents are truncated independently of code files.
Ensure cache key includes types flag so layer-on builds do not reuse layer-off cache entries.
Confirm wiki_enabled is actually wired into build_index; if missing, integrate it.

handoff.suggestion: Review _scope_key (likely in build_index) to confirm it includes wiki flag. Add a check in build_index that if documents are enabled but _collect_docs returns fewer files than expected (e.g., due to max_files), log a warning. For types, consider adding a cache key component for types_enabled or invalidating cache when flag changes. Verify wiki_enabled is called in build_index; if not, add the call to resolve wiki links.
